hypotheses.title: Industry-Neutralized 1080d LEAPS VRP with 10-Day Linear Decay Smoothing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies a 10-day linearly weighted moving average to the 1080d LEAPS / 120d historical volatility ratio before cross-sectional industry ranking. This smooths day-to-day options quote noise, compressing turnover from 11.3% down to ~7.5-8.0%, which mathematically lifts Fitness from 0.91 past 1.10 for full 8/8 gate approval.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if 10-day decay degrades Sharpe below 1.25.
